uncited: Opacity-based Early Termination is a family of volume rendering optimizations that halt the front-to-back ray integration loop once the accumulated opacity exceeds a predefined threshold, thereby skipping samples that contribute negligibly to the final pixel color.

It differs from [Empty-space skipping](1002-empty-space-skipping.md) by operating on the accumulated transmittance of the ray path rather than spatially culling empty voxels, and from [Russian Roulette](1371-russian-roulette.md) by using a deterministic cutoff rather than a probabilistic one, which introduces a systematic bias in exchange for reduced noise and computational cost.
by introducing conditions that break the loop early, skip iterations, or reduce the number of $C_{sample}$ queries.
